notes: This intraday report demonstrates typical real-time account reporting for 'Global Enterprises SA', a high-volume corporate treasury account with BNP Paribas. The floor limit of EUR 5,000 means only 4 high-value transactions are individually listed, but the summary totals reflect ALL 28 transactions that occurred from midnight to 14:30. This allows the bank to provide real-time visibility into major movements while keeping message size manageable for high-volume accounts. The pending entry (PDNG status) shows a EUR 15,000 tax payment held for compliance verification. This is the 3rd interim report of the day, indicating previous reports were sent earlier. This is semantically equivalent to an MT942 message with field 34F (floor limit), field 13D (14:30 timestamp), 4 field 61 entries above floor limit, and fields 90D/90C showing complete totals.
